! Original OpenSwing harmonic verification example. SI input units.
! Fixed root, axial stiffness k=500 N/m, tip mass m=2 kg, damping time .02 s.
! Engine setting is a force in N along +y. Set gravity to zero, alpha=0.
! Tip y response per unit setting: 1 / [500*(1+i*.02*omega)-2*omega^2].
Name
Instrumented spring-mass demonstrator
End
Unit
L 1 m
T 1 s
F 1 N
End
Constant
9.80665 1.225 340.294
End
Reference
2 1 2
End
Ground
1 0 0
End
Weight
1 2 0 2 0 19.6133
End
Engine
1 0 1 2 0 2 0 0 1 0 1 0 -1 0 0
End
Beam 1
Axial spring
t y EA tdeps
0 0 1000 .02
2 2 1000 .02
End

! Default body-aligned pylon-tip pitot, accelerometer and GPS.
Sensor
1 1 0 0 0 .2
2 1 2 .3 2 .2
End

limitations: The ASWING spline endpoint and cursor-editor algorithms are not specified by the public guide.
Tangent grafts are saved as natural-spline station approximations with checked value and slope tolerances.
The mechanical reference covers an axial beam with tip mass and Kelvin–Voigt damping, not arbitrary edited aircraft.
